## party_leader

Executes children effects on random characters that fulfills the "limit" trigger.Has to use has_ideology in limit to determine the party (with ideology group). tooltip=key can be added to override tooltip title

作用域：`country`

```ts
"party_leader"(value: Effect<ScopeByName["character"]> | { limit?: Trigger<ScopeByName["character"]>; effects: Effect<ScopeByName["character"]> } | CwtNode): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects_nsb.cwt:941](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_nsb.cwt#L941)；进入 `character` 作用域

## raid_add_unit_experience

Give experience to the units performing the raid (raid instance scope). Will give experience to any type of unit assigned to the raid, e.g. divisions or air wings. The value defines the progress towards the max level, e.g. 0.2 = gain 20% of the experience needed to reach max level. Can use either an explicit value or a variable

作用域：`raid`

```ts
"raid_add_unit_experience"(value: number): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects_gtd.cwt:294](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_gtd.cwt#L294)

## raid_damage_units

Damage the units performing the raid in scope (the attackers inflict losses). Damage is applied to ground units while damage to plane is defined as the amount of planes lost.\nIf 'ratio = yes', then all damage / losses are applied as a fraction of the current amount. For units, damage can be defined through one value 'damage' or separately through 'org_damage' and 'str_damage'

作用域：`raid`

```ts
"raid_damage_units"(value: { "org_damage"?: number; "str_damage"?: number; "damage"?: number; "plane_loss"?: number; "ratio"?: boolean } | CwtNode): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects_gtd.cwt:278](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_gtd.cwt#L278)

## raid_reduce_project_progress_ratio

Requires raid as ROOT scope. Reduce progress to the special project in state. Root scope is raid instance scope. The input value is a ratio of the total needed progress to complete the special project, i.e. a decimal number between 0 and 1.

作用域：`state`

```ts
"raid_reduce_project_progress_ratio"(value: number): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects_gtd.cwt:12](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_gtd.cwt#L12)

## reduce_focus_completion_cost

} &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cost = 15 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;focus = focus_to_be_reduced reduce_focus_completion_cost = { Example: The focus can be a uniform list or a single token. Reduce the cost needed to complete a specific focus. The cost accepts script constants.

## reserve_dynamic_country

Reserves a dynamic country so it won't be recycled for civil wars. A dynamic country with no owned states must be reserved after it is created and unreserved once it is no longer going to be used.

作用域：`COUNTRY`

```ts
"reserve_dynamic_country"(value: boolean): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects_new.cwt:314](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects_new.cwt#L314)
